block.name: chat_completion
block.title: Send messages to OpenAI GPT 4o Mini
block.description: Send messages to OpenAI GPT 4o Mini

properties.label: Text to send
properties.hint: Enter a message to start a conversation with ChatGPT.
properties.name: message

extended_input_schema.hint: Select the desired model from the picklist. If left blank, defaults to gpt-4o.
extended_input_schema.label: Model
extended_input_schema.name: model

toggle_field.name: model
toggle_field.label: Model
toggle_field.hint: Provide model ID that you want to use in your recipe. You can provide available models from Open AI or your fine tuned models. If left blank, defaults to gpt-4o. Learn more

extended_input_schema.hint: The function to execute. If you provide a function, the name, description, and parameters are required.
extended_input_schema.label: Function
extended_input_schema.name: function

properties.label: Function name
properties.hint: The name of the function to execute. Allowed characters: alphanumeric, hyphen, underscore.
properties.name: name

extended_input_schema.hint: Applied only when Function is provided. When Function is selected, the provided function will be used. This is the default. When Auto is selected, OpenAI will automatically determine whether to use the function or not. When None is selected, the function will not be used.
extended_input_schema.label: Tool choice
extended_input_schema.name: tool_choice

extended_input_schema.hint: Enter a value between 0 and 2 for controlling the randomness of chat completions. Higher values will make the output more random, while lower values will make it more focused and deterministic. It is recommended to use this or Top p but not both.
extended_input_schema.label: Temperature
extended_input_schema.name: temperature

extended_input_schema.hint: Enter a value between 0 and 1 for controlling the diversity of chat completions. A higher value will result in more varied responses. It is recommended to use this or Temperature but not both.
extended_input_schema.label: Top p
extended_input_schema.name: top_p

extended_input_schema.hint: The number of chat completions to generate for each input message. If left blank, defaults to 1. Multiples are only possible when temperature or top_p is non-zero
extended_input_schema.label: Number of chat completions
extended_input_schema.name: n

extended_input_schema.hint: Specific stop phrase that will end generation. For example, if you set the stop phrase to a period (.) the model will generate text until it reaches a period, and then it will stop.
extended_input_schema.label: Stop phrase
extended_input_schema.name: stop

extended_input_schema.hint: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion. Ensure the sum of this value and tokens in the input message doesn't exceed the model's maximum limit (4096 tokens for gpt-3.5-turbo).
extended_input_schema.label: Maximum tokens
extended_input_schema.name: max_tokens

extended_input_schema.hint: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics. See more information about frequency and presence penalties
extended_input_schema.label: Presence penalty
extended_input_schema.name: presence_penalty

extended_input_schema.hint: A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI to monitor and detect abuse. Learn more.
extended_input_schema.label: User
extended_input_schema.name: user

extended_input_schema.hint: Enter valid issue type name for the project.
extended_input_schema.label: Issue type
extended_input_schema.name: issuetype

extended_input_schema.hint: Provide issue ID or key of parent issue, e.g. 10105 (issue ID) or ABC-123 (issue key).Use issue ID if your issue moves between projects.
extended_input_schema.label: Parent
extended_input_schema.name: parent

extended_input_schema.hint: Enter sprint separated by commas. If the values have comma in it, make sure to give it as array of string using formula mode. For example: ["A,B,C", "D,E,F"]
extended_input_schema.label: Sprint
extended_input_schema.name: customfield_10020

extended_input_schema.hint: Enter flagged separated by commas. If the values have comma in it, make sure to give it as array of string using formula mode. For example: ["A,B,C", "D,E,F"]
extended_input_schema.label: Flagged
extended_input_schema.name: customfield_10021

extended_input_schema.hint: Enter design separated by commas. If the values have comma in it, make sure to give it as array of string using formula mode. For example: ["A,B,C", "D,E,F"]
extended_input_schema.label: Design
extended_input_schema.name: customfield_10032
